keyframe_review.note: 124,041 km2, 899 only. Cliopatria's Middle Franks row joins two states: Lothair I's Middle Francia (shape 850, right to 855) and, in 899, Zwentibold's Lotharingia. The Middle Francia page: infobox Established 843, Disestablished 855, and 'In 855 on his deathbed at Prum Abbey, Emperor Lothair I with the Treaty of Prum divided Middle Francia among his three sons'; the Lotharingia page: Arnulf appointed Zwentibold king of Lotharingia in 895 and he 'ruled semi-independently' until 13 August 900. The 899 shape therefore is not Middle Francia's and is reviewed (ok) in kingdom-of-lotharingia-zwentibold; the empty correction (the shape minus itself) says this dossier has no shape for 895-900. The first version of this dossier kept it as a second phase 895-900 (reviewer eu-07-d: split).

notes: Middle Francia (eu-07-d), two pages of two budgeted (Middle Francia, Lotharingia) plus East Francia (August 843) reused. Design, changed after the review. Cliopatria's Middle Franks row has two shapes, 850-859 (Lothair I's Middle Francia, wrongly continued to 859) and 899 (Zwentibold's Lotharingia). The first version kept both as two phases of one state (843-855 and 895-900, with a 39-year hole); the reviewer asked for the row to be split by state, as the brief says (section 6). This dossier is now Middle Francia only, 843-855: the pages split it in 855 among Louis II (kingdom-of-italy), Charles of Provence (lower-burgundy, found September 855 in that dossier) and Lothair II (kingdom-of-lotharingia, 855-869, still unwritten), and the dissolve event is 855. No keyframe exists for 856-859 (Cliopatria draws 850-859), which the successors carry. Zwentibold's kingdom (895-900), its ruler, its 899 keyframe, the 895 gain and the 900 loss moved to the new dossier kingdom-of-lotharingia-zwentibold (family france, Cliopatria Name Middle Franks); middle-franks_899 is reviewed here as wrong for Middle Francia and there as ok. East-franks records the matching split, vassal_start, vassal_end and gain. Cliopatria rows. 850-859 verdict adjust (holds 850-855); infobox area 350,000 km2 against 384,683, ratio 1.10 (the infobox gives no year; the text has 300,000 to 350,000). 899: wrong for this state. Cliopatria gives the Middle Franks no vassalage relation, only membership of the Carolingian Empire umbrella (850-859 and 899). Not settled. Counterpart kingdom-of-lotharingia (Lothair II, 855-869) needs a dossier (eu-07-x or a gap-filler). The wikidata id is the Cliopatria row's (Q6673921, tied to the Lotharingia article); the wikipedia field is Middle Francia, the page opened. Correction after the review: the first version's note quoted a boundary 'Aachen, Andernach, Louvain, Saint-Quentin and Alsace' and attributed it to the Lotharingia page and to Zwentibold's kingdom; the places occur in different paragraphs of that page and no sentence lists Zwentibold's territory, so the quotation and the attribution are dropped. Gazetteer: all names used resolve.
